caption: Quarantine is an explicit outcome. Only accepted evidence enters downstream analytical summaries.
Record counts reflect different sampling intervals; stationary nodes are not personnel.
SpO2 is entirely unavailable by design. This plot excludes absent records; later availability plots expose communication gaps.
The long-delay tail contains buffered records. Their historical availability must not be interpreted as timely availability during the outage.
Activity changes the feature distributions. Baseline normalization is worker- and activity-specific, rather than using a single population threshold.
The shaded interval is injected ground truth. The three-minute persistence rule creates a two-minute confirmation delay at the start of a strong episode.
Strong episodes are detected after persistence confirmation; weak episodes are missed at the reference threshold. Grey intervals represent observation limitations.
High precision coexists with missed weak episodes. These numbers characterize the configured synthetic generator only.
100 missed zone-minutes belong to weak episodes; another 20 arise from persistence delay. Episode counts and zone-minute counts must not be interchanged.
Different mixtures of strong and weak episodes change subgroup recall even under an unchanged detector.
The sweep uses the same synthetic dataset. It is exploratory and supplies no evidence of out-of-sample performance.
Variation reflects the chosen simulation family. Similar values across these seeds do not establish robustness to different physiological or operational conditions.
Cells with m > n are impossible and omitted. Codes 0/1/2 describe evidence states, not a measure of event severity.
The conflict is one extra input line and causes one complete identity to be quarantined. It is not an additional independent observation.
Quality gating and timeliness gating solve different problems; a complete transport record is not necessarily usable current evidence.
All devices can report while some samples remain late, missing or poor quality. Fresh-good fraction uses 36 expected last-minute samples.
Later-arriving records belong to history. Their eventual presence does not improve the original on-time completeness value.
Retrospective repair is useful for analysis but must not rewrite the evidence available at the time of an event.
Initial missing/unknown states reflect receipt delays. A link-loss event forces unknown evidence; it does not establish physical destruction or a casualty.
Unverified mounting and uncalibrated channels limit interpretation. The dashed line is the injected event time, not an independently inferred strike.
Timeline placement uses observation times. The as-of replay separately uses report times, preserving what was actually available at each cutoff.
Source classes constrain interpretation. An external strike report in this scenario is a simulated feed record, not a real-world incident claim.
Record-count zero represents absent observations. Points above the diagonal arrived later; connecting physiological values across that gap would hide the evidence loss.
The excerpt demonstrates record continuity and descriptive channel variation; it is not physiological or metrological validation.
The shaded outage contains absent records. This synthetic re-enactment verifies pipeline behavior and supplies no new measured evidence.
Reassembly is exact even when fragments arrive in reverse order in this test. Physical BLE transport is not exercised by the notebook.
The stepwise frontier results from indivisible services. Mandatory communications and lighting require at least three units before any solution is feasible.
Smaller sampling intervals increase the modeled data volume linearly. The assumed bytes per record should be replaced with measured values for an actual deployment.
All configured negative cases are rejected in this host-side demo. The finite challenge set does not prove comprehensive system security.
Agreement confirms software reproduction of supplied reference numbers. It does not validate the manuscript claims against independent physical experiments.
